description:
Cornelia, who married the aged Marquis Meitner at a young age and became a Marchioness, seemed to have gained freedom with the Marquis's death, but faced with the prospect of relinquishing her title and becoming penniless due to the absence of an heir, hatches a plan to seduce three attractive men who visit her husband's funeral. Isaac, a naive commoner who studied medicine; Richard, a profligate poet who warms the bedrooms of noblewomen with his eloquence and courtesan skills; and Theodore, a conquest-hungry Duke bent on conquering Cornelia.

 *"I've endured ten years, and now I'm in the arms of another old man?"
"Duke Theodore is a young duke. And—his breasts are bigger than yours."
"You should have said that first."* 

As they get to know Cornelia, the three men find themselves helplessly drawn to her honest yet cheeky demeanor. But who will remain by her side until the very end?

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
